title: Everyone Pay: Getting Started Guide
summary: Everyone Pay: Getting Started Guide explains how to access Everyone Pay in the app/web dashboard (Payments), add first contacts (Add Contact; save up to $550), verify contacts before the first transaction (follow prompts; verified indicator), and configure notifications and default funding account in Settings, plus safety tips to confirm recipient details each time.
faqs: How do I open Everyone Pay and view my contacts and recent activity?
What information can I use to add my first Everyone Pay contacts?
Is contact verification required before my first transaction, and how do I do it?
What is the maximum number/amount of contacts I can save ($550)?
Where do I enable notifications and review my default funding account/payment preferences?
What safety steps should I follow before sending a payment to a contact?
